import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Drop exact duplicate rows
    df = df.drop_duplicates()
    # Normalize text columns
    df['species'] = df['species'].astype(str).str.strip().replace({'Adeile': 'Adelie'})
    df['island'] = df['island'].astype(str).str.strip()
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower().replace({'nan': pd.NA})
    # Fix out-of-range body mass (values recorded in mg instead of g)
    df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].apply(lambda v: v / 1000 if pd.notna(v) and v > 6500 else v)
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = clean(df)
    g = df.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].mean()
    return {k: round(v, 2) for k, v in g.items()}
